body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News & Press Release> Panasonic announced re-branding of the VIERA line for all Plasma and LCD HD flat panel TVs.
Panasonic announced today at CES 2008, that its entire 2008 line of HD flat screen TV will be branded VIERA®.

The re-branding of its HD flat screen TVs for 2008 signals Panasonic's total commitment to the flat panel market, both in Plasma and LCD televisions. All 21 of the VIERA televisions provide the consumer with superb picture quality, convenient networking capabilities and superior customer service via its award winning Concierge program.

The 2008 designation of the VIERA brand also marks the introduction of two new screen sizes – a 46-inch Plasma and a 37-inch LCD – giving Panasonic a very deep line of high definition TVs to fit every application the consumer may have.

"VIERA signifies a new visual era," said Dennis Eppel, Panasonic Vice President, Panasonic Display Products Group. "With the VIERA brand crossing our HD flat panel lines, we now have a platform for a consistent marketing program that is built upon Panasonic's reputation for providing superior picture quality. Panasonic now can offer the consumer their choice from 26-inch to 65-inch TVs, all with a consistent cosmetic appearance. Panasonic has been an industry leader in television technology and as the new era of TVs prepares for the 2009 digital transition, we are confident that Panasonic will remain at the top of the class. Furthermore, with the 2008 Beijing Olympic games on the horizon, Panasonic, as an official Worldwide Olympic Partner, will be positioning the VIERA series HDTV as the Official HD TVs of the Olympic Games."
